headline: 167 commits today
prose:
**Sun 1 Nov** — StarRupture-ModLoader gained a feed-driven version map, and ten plugins moved to read game members through it. starrupture-ci got the matching map-only path, promotion and staging in dry-run form. A day of migration, merged branch by branch.

**Sat 31 Oct** — Version-map groundwork across the StarRupture stack: roughly 70 loader commits, 40 each in the SDK, Codex and CI. Also keybind handling fixes in the loader, and some Star Rupture Planner and Best Sudoku work.

**Fri 30 Oct** — Loader and Codex plugin: pause-menu mouse input became opt-in per widget, and a hung callback now names its plugin. Best Sudoku got a first-run welcome screen. `[REDACTED]` logged 20 commits, mostly fixes and releases.

**Thu 29 Oct** — Mostly workspace-bridge in Agent Plugins, 52 commits of features and fixes, plus startup layout checks in the ModLoader. `[REDACTED]` logged 99 commits, nearly all untyped. The shape suggests a bulk operation, nothing more.

**Wed 28 Oct** — Agent Plugins built out the workspace-bridge MCP server: handler, drive tools, drafts. Agent Templates and GSS Stats took smaller fixes and docs. `[REDACTED]` added eight commits, five of them fixes.
